item.title: Gambit 0.1.9
item.description:
# Gambit 0.1.9
Released November 5, 2026.
## Since 0.1.8
- **One engine, everywhere.** Gambit now runs on WebKit alone. Chromium is gone from this build: no bundled browser, roughly a tenth of the download, and Apple's security updates apply to the whole page engine instead of half of it. - **Chrome extensions still work.** WebKit runs real Manifest V3 extensions through Apple's own extension framework. uBlock Origin Lite blocks as before, and Jobright's helper panel loads and runs. A compatibility layer fills the small number of gaps between Chrome's extension APIs and WebKit's; it touches only Gambit's copy of an extension, never the one you installed. - **Docs, Sheets, and Slides.** Still editable, and text is sharp rather than soft on Retina displays. - **Passkeys still work** with the same Touch ID flow as 0.1.8. - **A correct app icon.** The Dock no longer shows a placeholder.
## Known limits
- Extensions that need `offscreen` documents or `userScripts` are not supported. Settings reports this per extension rather than failing silently. - An extension's toolbar popup may render blank even when the extension itself works on the page. - Installing from the Chrome Web Store opens the store page; the one-click install flow that Chromium provided is not reproduced yet. - A few sites assume Chromium-specific behavior. If one breaks, the page reports it rather than loading a blank view.
